issue.title: Infrastructure: repository cleaning
issue.body:
Go through the repository and:
- identify files that represented data output from tests that could be repeated (and hence the data deleted), schedule those files for deletion
- rationalize the logging and accounting infrastructure such that individual PRs would not easily create merge conflicts.

Suggest other repository cleaning options (with the aim to compress the repo a bit)

runner_input_paraphrase: Implement the bounded issue request in the isolated worktree. Read project governance, run relevant checks, prepare curated session and interaction evidence, keep raw data local, leave changes for human review. No push, GitHub writes, publication, labels, merges, approval, human sign-off, machine changes or sandbox bypass.
